intent: Repair reproducible diagnostic and open-issue failures, improve cause-bearing public reports and native Send/retry, validate the combined source, and close only issues whose resolution is established.

evidence_limits: The historical generic report bodies do not identify their original causes; no report UUID was present in the supplied capture.
New reporting context and correlation cannot reconstruct previously uncaptured evidence.
Live issue-reporter deployment and the repository Actions variable are not established by source changes or fake-publisher tests.
No physical Android device is attached; remaining device, private-service and formal acceptance requirements are not qualified.
Issue #674 also contains unfinished independently qualified semantic coverage/provenance implementation; the new directed-role guard repairs bounded false matches without completing that pipeline.

issue_closure_at_checkpoint.reason: Historical reports lack an incident-specific causal join; issue #674 also requires remaining qualified implementation and acceptance evidence.

main_update_reason: PR834 merged separately while the repair was in progress; its complete source history was already preserved by this branch.

required_actions: Deploy the updated HTTPS reporter and persistent state database with server-only GitHub App credentials.
Set repository Actions variable ISSUE_REPORT_ORIGIN to that deployed public HTTPS origin.
Rebuild the app and verify one explicitly approved report reaches GitHub with matching reportId receipt.
